nodes.name: styles.css
nodes.summary: Stylesheet customizing the appearance of the HTE deployment's Bokeh visualizer web pages.

nodes.name: gcld_client.py
nodes.summary: HTTP client wrapper around an external data-requests REST API, providing pydantic request/response models and a DataRequestsClient for creating, reading, updating, acknowledging, and status-tracking gcld data requests.

nodes.name: rcp_to_dict.py
nodes.summary: Utility that parses tab-indented .rcp instrument metadata files (optionally inside zip archives) into a nested Python dictionary.

nodes.name: zeroconf_manager.drawio
nodes.summary: Draw.io diagram documenting the design of the Zeroconf/mDNS service-registration manager.

nodes.name: zeroconf_manager.py
nodes.summary: Wraps python-zeroconf's AsyncZeroconf to register and unregister HELAO server services over mDNS, exposing simple enable/disable methods that drive the async registration coroutines.

layers.name: Framework Core
layers.description: Deployment-agnostic HELAO framework: base FastAPI/Bokeh server classes, the data-browser/orchestrator base APIs, Pydantic models for Action/Experiment/Sequence/Sample, the micro-orchestrator runners, and the RPC layer in helao/core.

layers.name: Helpers & Utilities
layers.description: Cross-cutting utilities under helao/helpers: config loading, logging, the async HTTP dispatcher, premodels, and YAML/HLO/parquet/zmq helpers shared by every server.

layers.name: Hardware Drivers
layers.description: Instrument backends implementing the HelaoDriver ABC: the core driver contract plus the HTE deployments vendor-specific hardware and data-sync drivers.

layers.name: Action & Visualizer Servers
layers.description: HTE FastAPI action servers that wrap drivers and expose /<key>/<action> endpoints, plus the Bokeh visualizer apps that subscribe to status/data WebSockets and render plots.

layers.name: Orchestration & Launch
layers.description: Orchestrator and operator server apps plus the root launch/orchestration tooling (launch.py, fast/bokeh launchers, append, cli, shell/bat wrappers) that compose and run a server group.

layers.name: Experiment & Sequence Library
layers.description: Importable experiment, sequence, specification, processor, and layout definitions for the HTE deployment that the orchestrator dynamically loads per config.

layers.name: Configuration
layers.description: Station orchestration-group YAMLs, conda environment specs, and tool config files that define server groups and the build/runtime environment.

layers.name: Testing
layers.description: Unit-test runners and standalone test/dry-run scripts under core/tests and the deployment, including the model unit test and per-driver/server test scripts.

layers.name: Documentation
layers.description: Project documentation and licensing: CLAUDE.md, readme, LICENSE, and the runners design note.
